about: Grants.gov / Simpler.Grants.gov: US federal grant opportunities. The CLI searches and exports funding opportunities, gets opportunity details from the classic Grants.gov web service, looks up agencies, searches site content, reads CMS pages, and lists the daily XML database extracts and RSS feeds.

commands.summary: Search federal funding opportunities on simpler.grants.gov by keyword, with status, funding-instrument, eligibility and category filters, sort and paging. Returns the raw Next.js RSC text payload, whi

params.name: sortby
params.description: Sort order. Relevancy is the default.

params.name: status
params.description: Opportunity status. Comma-separate multiple values: forecasted, posted, closed, archived. The UI default is forecasted,posted.

params.name: fundingInstrument
params.description: Funding instrument. Comma-separate multiple values: grant, cooperative_agreement, procurement_contract, other.

params.name: eligibility
params.description: Eligible applicant type code, comma-separated, e.g. nonprofits_non_higher_education_with_501c3, state_governments, individuals

params.name: category
params.description: Funding category code, comma-separated, e.g. health, education, environment, science_technology_and_other_research_and_development

commands.summary: Export opportunity search results as CSV. Takes the same keyword, filter and sort params as search-opportunities.

params.name: status
params.description: Comma-separated statuses: forecasted, posted, closed, archived

params.name: eligibility
params.description: Comma-separated eligible applicant type codes, e.g. nonprofits_non_higher_education_with_501c3

params.name: category
params.description: Comma-separated funding category codes, e.g. health

commands.summary: Search Grants.gov website content (help articles, forms, learning pages) through the Search.gov API.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get a published Grants.gov CMS page (Storyblok story) by slug.
List the daily Grants.gov XML database extract files (GrantsDBExtractYYYYMMDDv2.zip), with download URL, size and date.
List the Grants.gov RSS feed links for new and modified opportunities, by agency and by category.
